# GitHub Copilot Source-to-Documentation Kit

Native repository customization:
- `.github/copilot-instructions.md` — always-on rules
- `.github/instructions/` — path-specific rules
- `.github/agents/` — custom specialist agents
- `.github/prompts/` — reusable prompts
- `.github/skills/` — reusable agent skills
- `.github/templates/` — Japanese documentation templates
- `.github/references/` — methodology
- `.github/scripts/` — deterministic quality checks

Start with the `docs-orchestrator` agent or `generate-documentation.prompt.md`.
